# WCAG 2.2 Site and PDF Scanner 5.0.2

Version 5.0.2 is a corrective distribution-only update. It does not broaden scanner behavior or change the evidence and manual-review boundaries documented for 5.0.1.

## Why this patch exists

Qualification of the unpublished 5.0.1 draft found that its source distribution included the release builder and release tests but omitted the versioned release notes required by those tests. Runtime installation, diagnostics, synthetic website and PDF reporting, and Chromium behavior passed, but the package was not self-testing.

The public `v5.0.1` tag remains fixed. Its draft release was not published, and this patch uses a new version rather than moving or reusing that tag.

## Correction

- Includes versioned release notes and the tag workflow in the source distribution.
- Uses a generic release-notes manifest rule so later patch versions inherit the same package contract.
- Requires repeat builds to contain both release inputs before release assets are accepted.
- Canonicalizes regular source-archive member modes across mounted Windows filesystems and native Git checkouts.
- Runs the complete 27-test suite, including four real Chromium checks, from both the source tree and an extracted source distribution.

## Distribution integrity

- Provides an exact standalone Python runtime, normalized pure-Python wheel, normalized source distribution, SPDX 2.3 dependency SBOM, SHA-256 checksums, and machine-readable release evidence.
- Requires two independent builds to produce the same six files byte for byte.
- Attests all six release assets with GitHub build provenance.
- Creates only a draft GitHub release from a tag pointing to a verified protected-main commit.
- Does not publish to PyPI. Registry publication requires separate trusted-publisher setup and approval.

## Important boundaries

Automated findings are evidence, not proof of WCAG, Section 508, or PDF/UA conformance. Complete evaluation still requires manual review, assistive-technology testing, and judgment about the content and its purpose.

Scan only systems and documents you own or are authorized to test. Reports may contain page text, element markup, URLs, file paths, and screenshots, so protect them according to the sensitivity of the source content.

## Assets

- `WCAG-Site-PDF-Scanner-v5.0.2.py`: exact standalone runtime
- `wcag_site_pdf_scanner-5.0.2-py3-none-any.whl`: Python wheel
- `wcag_site_pdf_scanner-5.0.2.tar.gz`: normalized source distribution
- `WCAG-Site-PDF-Scanner-v5.0.2.spdx.json`: SPDX 2.3 dependency SBOM
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: SHA-256 digests for the runtime, packages, and SBOM
- `release-evidence.json`: source commit, artifact identities, dependencies, and archive membership

Verify all checksums and provenance before installation. Start with the included synthetic site and review the generated report before scanning an authorized live target.
